headline: [Gangnam Perspective] Homeplus: Only Ten Days to Fill the Shelves
summary: Homeplus, pushed to the brink of bankruptcy last month, received emergency funding that laid groundwork for a recovery. A columnist warns that store closures and shifting consumer habits threaten its survival.
why: Homeplus is a South Korean large-format discount retailer, and its restructuring affects suppliers, landlords and employees in Korea's retail sector.
